headline: Public hearings on a fueling canopy variance at 180 Riverside Avenue and a canopy at the ESPN North Gate at Ronzo Road.
summary: Two public hearings cover requests for height variances to build canopies. One is a fueling canopy at 180 Riverside Avenue, which also needs a front yard variance on a State highway; the other is a canopy at the ESPN North Gate at Ronzo Road.
items: Public hearing on Application #3835: variance from Article II, Section 5.4.2. for the maximum height of an accessory structure to erect a canopy at the North Gate of the ESPN campus at Ronzo Road; Assessor's Map 4, Lot 1; IP-1 (Industrial Park) zone; L.I.C. Warehouse Realty Company, Inc, applicant/owner.

Public hearing on Application #3836: new variances from Article II, Section 8.1.D. for the minimum front yard on a State highway and from Article II, Section 5.4.2. for the maximum height of an accessory structure to erect a fueling canopy at 180 Riverside Avenue; Assessor's Map 30, Lot 117-B; BHC (Route 72 Corridor Business) zone; ESHAA, LLC c/o Khalid Mahmood, applicant.
location: City Hall, Council Chambers, First Floor, 111 North Main Street
